name: Diamond Push Up
instructions: Start in a high plank and place your hands under your chest with thumbs and index fingers forming a diamond.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward your hands, elbows close to your body.
Press back up to straight arms.
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: A push-up with the hands close together under the chest that shifts more work to the triceps.
